title: Bharateeyatha
author: Satguru Sri Sivananda Murty
description: A compilation of more than 500 articles on Indian culture, history and dharma, originally written for Andhra Bhumi.

title: Supatha
author: Sanathana Supatha Publications
description: A cultural magazine covering language, literature, music, poetry, art, history, temples and tradition.

title: Margadarsakulu Maharshulu
author: Satguru Sri Sivananda Murty
description: On forty-one maharishis, drawn from the narrative of a twenty-eight day yagna held in 1994.

title: Kathayoga
author: Satguru Sri Sivananda Murty
description: A commentary on the Katha Upanishad, published by Aditya Prakashan, New Delhi.

title: Mana Katha
author: Satguru Sri Sivananda Murty
description: A history of Andhra Pradesh, adapted into a thirteen-episode serial broadcast by Doordarshan, Hyderabad, which received a state Nandi award.

title: Tathagata Buddha
author: Satguru Sri Sivananda Murty
description: A feature film script, later published as an illustrated book. The film received the Special Jury Nandi award.

title: Suvarnabhoomi
author: Satguru Sri Sivananda Murty
description: On the cultural connections between India and South-East Asia. Published by Santhana Supatha Publications.
